description: Bisimulation is a shrink strategy for merge-and-shrink: it groups the states of a factor (one transition system of the factored task) that behave alike. Two states are *bisimilar* when both are goal states or both are not, and every label leads them into the same group. The crate starts with groups of equal goal distance and splits each group by the `(label, target group)` pairs of its states (*signature refinement*), until no group splits. On plain SAS+ tasks without a size limit, the final heuristic is then perfect: it equals the optimal cost on every state (every reachable state, with pruning). With `max_states`, it stops splitting at the limit, and the heuristic stays admissible (it never overestimates).
